endorsements.name: Videoman
endorsements.label: Hacking with GNURadio
endorsements.description: This presentation I will focus on the requirements for GnuRadio, cost, code, and radio technology basics. I will also present some of attacks that have been created using the GnuRadio, as well as my own research from a successful hack of a proprietary Multiple Address System (MAS) SCADA network, and a quick demo of the GnuRadio in action.
